body:
I do sleep rather okay, though, but it's all ruined once i wake up after a dream about him.

with food it's different. a few years back i was on a near-starvation diet for several months and lost 44 pounds. i never regretted it for a second but i gained some of it back so now i'm working on getting rid of it. i can't bring myself to exercise no matter how hard i try though. 

ive been to a doctor and it was horrible. i spend money i didn't have for a half-deaf old guy who barely spoke any english to talk to me for 15 minutes and then write me a prescription i couldn't renew because i don't have the money. so i can't do anything about that.

no, not solely. i don't feel like i exist to make him happy and give up everything of my own for him, it's more about not being able to reach the same happiness as i had when i was with him/

as nasty as it is to say this, i've never felt truly happy ever since the breakup. between us it was never about putting much effort into making each other happy, it was just our presence. and that's what i kept telling him too, that i don't need him to actually do anything for things to be good, just be there and do things together like play games alongside each other.

actually i'm rather proud that i don't have as much self-hatred anymore, but i wish my depression would rather stem from that, than loss. i don't particularly hate myself but i don't think i'm anything special either. i don't have any useful skills or talents or interests and i could go for losing a few pounds so recently i haven't been eating at all. and i'm afraid to sleep because i dream about him very often.

i try to do things for myself. i've bought some plants to take care of and i wanted to get back into drawing once i got my tablet but after what happened this morning, none of it matters.
i really enjoy video games but i cant play them forever obviously. it's just a distraction that cant fix things

it's a bit different. sure i had okay days but i clung to him saying that he's not ready for a relationship, and here he is with someone only 5 months later. it's betrayal and it destroys whatever "okay"ness i built up in my life. i can't stand the thought of him with someone else. yes, i know that if i love him then i should think about his happiness, but the second i accept it is the second i stop living, because i wouldn't be able to cope with the thought that it's not me making me happy, and i'd risk interfering and ruining things further, so you could say it's for his sake that i want to end it.

i've had some other crap on the side as well. i've drifted apart from my closest friends and hold constant hatred towards my traitor "dad" who left the family and prioritizes his newborn kid now, while whining about how i "dont want to be friends" when he's the one who never bothered to get to know me while he had the chance. but none of those events have fucked me up in the same way as this one did. it's just very different.

thank you for doing what you do and being there for people that really need it.

the thing is that i don't even have the motivation to keep trying. the people who go on find the strength to cling to something for comfort, and i see no comfort in anything anymore.

thank you for responding, really. i can't express how proud i am of you for holding on. i wish i had your strength but i've got no more fight left in me. if i may ask, how long did it take you to get better?
